# Version 4.151.0
> **Managed performance and Skia m151** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 updates to Skia m151 and ports several hot-path conversions from native to managed C#. This release focuses on interop and allocation overhead: color/premultiply conversions, HarfBuzzSharp tag parsing, and shaper glyph access all move to zero-copy or fully-managed code. It also fixes a native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData and picks up several rounds of Chrome M151 upstream fixes.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m151** — The bundled engine is bumped to Chrome milestone m151, plus multiple follow-up rounds of upstream m151 bug-fix merges. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489), [#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382), [#4312](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4312), [#3788](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3788))

## API Surface

- **GRContextOptions no longer requires unsafe** — Removes an unnecessary `unsafe` modifier requirement from GRContextOptions, simplifying consumer code that touches GPU context options. ([#3991](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3991))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI)** — Fixes a native resource leak that occurred when decoding an image with an explicit subset rectangle. ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Hot-path conversions ported from native to managed C#** — SKColor→SKColorF conversion, single-value SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply, SKColor hex parsing, HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8 and Tag.Parse, SKFourByteTag.Parse, and SKShaper glyph-result access are all reimplemented in managed code or as zero-copy spans, cutting P/Invoke and allocation overhead on these paths. ([#4370](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4370), [#4385](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4385), [#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345), [#4376](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4376), [#4408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4408), [#4396](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4396), [#4388](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4388))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8(string) becomes allocation-free via a pooled UTF-8 encode, and Tag.Parse drops a per-call char[4] allocation, alongside the bundled HarfBuzz refresh to 14.2.1.
